query:
SELECT 
  t.nome AS tecnico,
  COUNT(os.id) AS total_os,
  COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(os.concluidoEm / 1000))) AS dias_trabalhados,
  ROUND(COUNT(os.id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(os.concluidoEm / 1000))), 0), 1) AS media_os_por_dia,
  MIN(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(os.concluidoEm / 1000))) AS primeiro_dia,
  MAX(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(os.concluidoEm / 1000))) AS ultimo_dia
FROM ordens_servico os
JOIN tecnicos t ON t.id = os.tecnicoId
WHERE os.status = 'concluida'
  AND os.concluidoEm IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.id, t.nome
ORDER BY media_os_por_dia DESC;
